projects.name: DashSupport.Team
projects.tagline: The community-led support team for every builder on Dash — humans + Dasha AI, 24/7.
projects.desc: The founding project of Dash Alive. A community-led support organization for the whole Dash DAO: Dasha AI answering 24/7 on web, Telegram, and X with her entire mind open source; the Dream, Design, and Build teams; the Dash Design Library commons; the Pulse (radical, anonymous transparency); and Dash Alive itself — the live database, ballot box, and support treasury for everything alive on Dash. Built first, asked second.
